title: Australian Vegetable Skewers
description: A kid-friendly Australian dish featuring galangal paste, this recipe is perfect for outdoor gatherings, with a peppery and springy flavor that is sure to delight, and is jain-friendly.

ingredients.name: mushrooms
ingredients.notes: button or cremini, cut into 1-inch pieces

instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together galangal paste, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Add the zucchini, bell peppers, onions, mushrooms, and cherry tomatoes to the bowl and toss to coat with the galangal paste mixture.
Thread the vegetables onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the vegetables are tender and lightly charred.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
